Partly conceded as a record matter — the tap at 613 m (F6) plus the station at 613 m (F2) is the NS-2 arrival-not-at-pickup situation, and his 2 upheld no-show disputes in 90 days (F20) are relevant background — but NS-9 flags the rider, not the driver, so the rider's profile (F19: 0 disputes) and the driver's history cannot decide this case; a flag review is a system add-on, not a finding, and my client does not oppose it being recorded.

notices.text: Good news — your $5.00 no-show cancellation fee is being refunded in full. It goes back to the payment method you originally used. We looked at the trip record: the driver marked himself as arrived while he was still over 600 metres from the pickup point, so the arrival requirement for charging a no-show fee wasn't met, and the wait and contact requirements weren't met either. Your messages during the trip matched what the location data showed. Nothing else is affected — the fee is the only amount in question. No action is needed from you.

We reviewed your no-show cancellation on this trip. The $5.00 fee is being refunded to the rider, so it will not be paid to you. The deciding facts: your "I'm here" tap was recorded more than 600 metres from the pickup point, your closest approach during the trip was still about 612 metres away, and the platform never logged an arrival at the pickup. A valid wait therefore never started. Separately, we've noted on your account that arrival was marked away from the pickup point, and your account is now flagged for review. We'll be looking at arrival marking on your future trips.
